busy: The robot is busy. Please wait a moment.
err_generic: Something went wrong. You can try again.
err_mac: The computer that helps the robot is not answering. Let's try again.
err_timeout: This is taking too long. Let's try again.
err_no_audio: I couldn't hear you. Come closer to the microphone and speak a bit louder.
err_no_speech: I couldn't understand what you said. Shall we try again?
err_sign_off: The sign camera is not ready. Try your voice or typing.
err_drawing: I couldn't finish the drawing. Let's try again.
err_box_busy: The box is still finishing the previous scan. Please wait.
err_scan: The scan did not finish well. Check the box and let's try again.
toast_sign_empty: No text yet. Sign letters or words and tap them.
home_kicker: A robot that listens, draws and discovers
home_title: Hello! What shall we do today?
home_lead: Tell me a story and I'll draw it on paper, or put an ancient object in the box and let's find out where it comes from.
door_story_d: With your voice in any language, in sign language or by typing. I'll draw it for you.
door_scan_d: I turn it, light it, look at it under UV and with heat, and tell you what it is.
home_foot: Yachachiq means “the one who teaches” in Quechua.
method_title: How do you want to tell it?
method_voice_d: In Spanish, Quechua, Aymara or any language you speak.
method_sign_d: LSP, ASL or International Sign, in front of the camera.
method_sign_off: The sign camera is not ready right now.
voice_hint: Speak calmly. When you stop talking, the robot stops listening by itself.
listening_hint: Tell your story. Tap the button when you finish.
sign_waiting: Sign in front of the camera…
sign_what: What did you sign? Tap the right one
lang_type_hint: Type a few letters of the language…
confirm_detected: I understood {lang}. Did you speak another language?
translate_failed: I couldn't translate it now (that's OK).
consent_nocam: I can't find the camera: use the buttons.
consent_covered: Camera covered: your story will not be published.
consent_smile: Lovely smile! It will be published with your photo.
consent_face: I see you. Smile if you want to share it.
consent_open: Camera open. Cover it if you'd rather not publish.
consent_lead: Your story and drawing can go to Yachachiq's public online archive, with a photo of you and without your name.
consent_no_d: Cover the camera with your hand or tap “No”. It stays only in the robot.
consent_yes_t: Yes, I want to share it
consent_yes_d: Look at the camera and smile, or tap “Yes”.
consent_fine: If you do nothing, the story is published with your photo.
consent_thanks_d: Your story joins the Yachachiq archive.
consent_private_d: Your story stays saved only in this robot.
printer_drawing_back: Writing your story and the QR
printer_offline: The printer is not connected; your drawing was saved
holo_playing: Watch your story in the hologram
done_qr_public: Scan to see your story online (uploaded when there is internet)
done_qr_private: Scan to see the Yachachiq archive
done_public: Thank you for telling your story to Yachachiq.
done_private: Your story was saved only in the robot.
scan_intro_title: Put your object in the box
scan_step2: Place the object in the middle of the plate.
preflight_busy: The box is finishing the previous scan.
stopping_sub: Turning off the lights and the heat.
thermal_wait: The thermal camera is used at the end.
meas_note: “±” is the margin of error: the real value is very likely inside that range.
viewer_missing: This view is not available for this scan.
uv_explain: Under UV light, modern glues and restorations usually glow differently from ancient pottery.
th_explain: We warm the object just a little. Where there are cracks or fillings, heat moves differently.
model_hint: Drag with one finger to turn it. Use two fingers to zoom.
rti_hint: Drag your finger: you move the light.
model_explain: 3D model built from many photos taken while the plate turned.
rti_explain: Raking light shows carvings and marks that are almost invisible in a normal photo.
ctx_lead: It is a clue to recognise it, not proof: if it does not match what we see, the image wins. If you don't know, tap “Skip”.
ctx_placeholder: E.g.: at a huaca near Trujillo
ctx_no_audio: I couldn't hear you well. Try again or type it.
id_compare: From the image only: {a} · With the place: {b}
